annotations.title: Air quality at a place in Belgium (now, forecast, annual)

description: Air quality at an address or point anywhere in Belgium from IRCEL-CELINE, read live: this hour's modelled NO2, PM2.5, PM10, ozone and black carbon for the 4 km cell, the last 24-hour PM means against the WHO 24-hour guidelines, the BelAQI forecast for today and the next three days (1 excellent to 10 horrible), annual means of the last complete year (street level in Flanders via ATMO-Street, 4 km background elsewhere) compared with the WHO 2021 guidelines and the current and 2030 EU limit values, and the nearest measuring stations that are reporting now (out-of-service stations are skipped and named). Includes the municipality (NIS code) with its population and income. Starts with key_facts; cite IRCEL-CELINE (CC BY 4.0). Examples: How is the air in central Brussels now, and over the year? → {"address":"Rue Neuve 1, 1000 Bruxelles"}; Air quality forecast for Liège → {"address":"Place Saint-Lambert 1, 4000 Liège"}; Annual NO2 at street level near Antwerp central station → {"latitude":51.2194,"longitude":4.4025}.

address.description: Address in Belgium, e.g. 'Grote Markt 1, 3000 Leuven' or 'Place Saint-Lambert 1, 4000 Liège'.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude, e.g. 51.0453 (use with longitude instead of address).

x_lambert72.description: Belgian Lambert 72 (EPSG:31370) x in metres, as an alternative to latitude/longitude.
